# The muzzle flash: three crossed spikes 0.9 m long, unlit cream. Origin at its centre.
new
material new Fire --base-color 1.0000 0.9255 0.8392 --no-slot --emission 1.0000 0.9255 0.8392
add mesh cube --name F0 --size 1 --location 0 0 0
scale 0.9 0.2 0.2
apply --scale
add mesh cube --name F1 --size 1 --location 0 0 0
scale 0.2 0.9 0.2
apply --scale
add mesh cube --name F2 --size 1 --location 0 0 0
scale 0.2 0.2 0.9
apply --scale
select F0 F1 F2
active F0
join
set rotation 30 20 40
apply --rotation
material assign Fire
shade flat
export flash.glb
